name: beam-worker
description: Dependency for worker/index.js (Beam's Cloudflare Worker: push-notification subscriptions + the weekly check that sends them). Lives at the repo root, not inside worker/, on purpose — Cloudflare's Git-integration build only auto-runs `npm install` when it finds package.json at the root, before bundling wrangler.toml's `main` entry. Everything else about Beam is still a static site served straight from the repo; this is the one piece with a real dependency.
